Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Reinstated Amid Political Pressure and AI Concerns

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has been reinstated following a period of political engagement and speculation. His return has drawn reactions from various figures, including Elon Musk and former President Donald Trump, who reportedly directed efforts to help Huang regain his position. While some, like Musk and Trump, have welcomed the comeback, Democratic lawmakers have expressed criticism regarding Huang's approach to China's chip market and potential national security risks associated with AI chip sales. Jensen Huang and Nvidia's General Counsel are expected to face the U.S. Congress concerning these issues. Separately, speculation arose regarding Huang's personal life, with reports suggesting his wife could be entitled to half of their estimated $145 billion fortune in the event of a divorce, given California's community property laws. Nvidia's stock saw a sharp rise following the reinstatement.
